notes.title: Patch 0.0.8
notes.notes:
1.Game difficulty balance. Add 3 difficulty selections.Improve monster spawn design.
//Because many players feedback game is easy in early patches. we lose the difficulty balance.
2.Reduce the punishment of movement(Backward..urn left/right).Improve player base movement speed.
//Now player can dodge monster attack and fight back in backward movement.Improve player operating space.
3.Controls Menu Add gamepad operating instructions and more keybind instructions.
4.Improve gamepad/keyboard UI navigation,highlight focus selection
5.Add Boss kill and crossroad map unlock achievement.
6.Bug fix player graphic settings and audio settings reset after relogin game.
7.Add 4 new language selections// Portuguess . Spanish . Polish . Chinese(Traditional)
